conditions: Fresh subagents; same inherited parent model/configuration and tool surface; identical cases; separate output directories; no rubric, diagnosis, expected answer or other run visible to executors.
primary_decision: Whether the revised workflow yields a more stable explicit change-impact handoff across all 3x3 task executions without over-invalidating unaffected work.
acceptance: Candidate must not regress any criterion. Reliability improvement may be claimed only if candidate has fewer criterion failures/unclear results across runs; n=3 per variant is exploratory and not a significance test.
telemetry: Use only exposed timestamps/usage/cost. Do not infer model ID, tokens or cost.
